meta.name: firebase-data-connect
meta.description: Builds and deploys Firebase SQL Connect (aka Firebase Data Connect) backends with PostgreSQL securely. Use when designing schemas with tables and relations, writing authorized queries and mutations, configuring real-time data updates, or generating type-safe SDKs. Use when you need a relational database with Firebase, or when the user mentions SQL Connect or Data Connect.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你搭 Firebase SQL Connect(即 Data Connect)后端:用 PostgreSQL 设计 schema 的表和关系、写带授权规则的查询与变更、配置实时数据更新,并生成类型安全的客户端 SDK。
howto.when: 当你提到「SQL Connect」「Data Connect」等关键词,或需要用 Firebase 搭配关系型数据库、要设计 schema 时触发。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude builds and deploys Firebase SQL Connect (Data Connect) backends on PostgreSQL: designing schemas with tables and relations, writing authorized queries and mutations, configuring real-time updates, and generating type-safe SDKs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "SQL Connect" or "Data Connect", or need a relational database with Firebase: schema design, authorized operations, SDK generation.

say_en.text: Design a SQL Connect schema for a movies app with a rating relation
Generate the TypeScript SDK for this connector
say_en.note: Outputs to the dir set in connector.yaml
